_play: The Play pages' data (ui/pages/quick_join.rml, ranked.rml, training.rml). Quick Play is live (P8, oz_ui_social.cpp): region is the Settings' region as the page opens, status the search (searching, joining, far, none, failed or nothing), asked and asked_name the mode an answer is for, text what the page says. Matchmaking and ranked come with P8b: the queues and ratings here are stand-ins (the web menu's mock), and their actions are refused. Training's drills start offline matches where the game can run them now.

modes.name: Duel
modes.text: One on one (the original game's Tournament).

modes.name: Capture the Flag
modes.text: Take the enemy flag to your own base while yours is home.

modes.name: Clan Arena
modes.text: Rounds, no pickups, everyone spawns with every weapon and full armor.

modes.name: Freeze Tag
modes.text: Kills freeze instead of kill; teammates thaw you by standing next to you.

modes.name: Instagib
modes.text: Railguns only, one hit kills, no pickups.

queues.name: Duel
queues.text: 1v1 on the tournament maps. The headline ladder.

queues.name: Team Deathmatch
queues.text: Ranked against the other team's average rating.

queues.name: Capture the Flag
queues.text: Full teams; everyone on a team moves together.

how.name: Placement
how.text: Your first 10 ranked matches place you. Everyone starts at 1,000 MMR, and your rank shows once placement is done.

how.name: MMR
how.text: Your matchmaking rating moves after every match, like chess Elo: beat someone rated above you and you gain more, lose to someone below and you drop more. What one player gains, the other loses.

how.name: Settling in
how.text: Ratings swing fast at first (up to 40 points a match for your first 30 matches), then settle (24), and move slowest in Godlike (16).

how.name: Divisions
how.text: Every tier has three divisions, III to II to I, each 100 MMR. Godlike has no ceiling.

how.name: Seasons
how.text: A season lasts three months. When it ends, your rating eases a quarter of the way back toward 1,000, and you keep the frame and title of the highest tier you reached.

how.name: Fair play
how.text: Fixed rules and an official map pool, banned in turn. Matches start in your region, a result counts only when every player's game agrees on it, and leaving is a loss.

drills.name: Movement
drills.text: Strafe jumping, circle jumps and rocket jumps on Introduction, alone.

drills.name: Railgun aim
drills.text: Instagib against three moving bots on The Longest Yard.
drills.do: sound buzz; toast Railgun aim needs Instagib, which isn't in the game code yet.

drills.name: Duel practice
drills.text: Ten minutes against a Hardcore Sarge on Powerstation 0218.

drills.name: Item timing
drills.text: Learn the armor and mega health cycles on The Camping Grounds.
